text:
nina: Heads-up : ran a microtest on IA regrouping. New idea: collapse Models, Deployments, and Runtimes under a single parent called 'Serve' for non-ML audiences. Mock: https://img.redwood/mock/serve-rail.png. Main concerns: deep-link fidelity, breadcrumb truncation on small viewports, and localized labels. Thoughts?

 tj: Quick take : I'm worried about discoverability for platform teams who expect 'Models' at top-level. If we use 'Serve', we should keep canonical route paths human-readable like /serve/models/:id for SEO/bookmarks.

 olivia: Accessibility notes: breadcrumb should be semantic nav > ol and should expose aria-current on the active item. For truncated breadcrumbs on mobile, provide an accessible "You are here" label that reads full path, e.g., "You are here: Inference > Models > Foo". Screenreaders mustn't rely on visual truncation.

 maria: On localization, some locales expand label length significantly. If we collapse to 'Serve' (short) but translate into long words, breadcrumb overflow will be worse. We could compute breadcrumb collapse with an accessible tooltip that contains the full path in the user's language. l10n-bot, any concerns?

 l10n-bot: Localization reminder: translations for nav labels vary by 2-4x length. Suggest reserving 120px min for top-level or allow label to ellipsize with a full aria-label containing the expanded breadcrumb. Also send copy strings to i18n for QA.

 kevin: Routing technical: avoid ephemeral hashes. Prefer real nested routes so deep links land cleanly and history works: e.g., /serve/models/:id/metrics. We'll maintain server redirects for old routes and preserve query strings. Example mapping:```js
// routing map
{
  "/models/:id": "/serve/models/:id",
  "/deployments/:id": "/serve/deployments/:id",
  "/runtimes/:id": "/serve/runtimes/:id"
}
```

 sam: Implementation notes: when a deep link arrives we should do three things in order: 1) expand parent nav programmatically, 2) set aria-expanded=true on the revealed parent, 3) move keyboard focus to the main H1 or primary CTA. That avoids SRs missing context. Also we'll emit a telemetry event when a redirect occurs so we can track broken bookmarks.

 nina: UX question: do we keep the top-level label visible in breadcrumbs? e.g., Serve / Models / Foo vs Models / Foo. I slightly prefer keeping it to provide context for grouped items.

 tj: Keep it. But for compact width, show condensed form: Serve · Models · Foo (with visual separators), and ensure the condensed variant has an accessible expanded label.

 olivia: QA checklist for this change: 1) deep link landing with collapsed rail; 2) focus after route resolution; 3) aria-expanded changes announced; 4) breadcrumb SR full readout for truncated views; 5) preserved query params across redirects; 6) localized breadcrumb copy verified.

 kevin: One more edge: internal links generated from emails or docs might reference old slugs. Server-side 301/302 with preserved queries is fine, but we should also emit a small transient notice in UI when a redirect was used: "You were redirected from /models/123 to /serve/models/123" with a dismiss button. Helps users report stale links.

 sam: Agreed. I'll add: history.replaceState should be used for the redirect client-side to avoid stacking entries. Also add a migration table in the router config so we can programmatically look up old->new for resolve time.

 nina: Can we add a small animation when expanding the parent on deep-link so keyboard users notice the change? Keep it short for performance.

 olivia: Animation okay if reduced motion preference is respected. If reduce-motion is set, skip animation and ensure focus jump is immediate.

 l10n-bot: Sending UI copy tasks to localization: tooltip strings, redirect banner, condensed breadcrumb aria-labels. Expect ETA 48 hours.

 nina: Deploy preview plz? Would like to test on a narrow screen and RTL locale.

 sam: Deployed a prototype: https://deploy.redwood/pr/1533 (serve-rail-proto). Includes keyboard walkthrough and a small RTL toggle. Note: currently prototype uses client-side redirect and preserves querystring.

 kevin: Checked PR: when landing on /models/abc the prototype redirects but the breadcrumb briefly flashes old label before replacing. Suggest holding render until redirect is resolved to avoid flash.

 sam: I'll change the router to resolve redirects before mounting the breadcrumb component. Add small loading skeleton to avoid layout jank.

 nina: Great. Action items: Sam implements pre-resolve redirects + focus behavior, Kevin: spec server-side redirect headers and analytics, Olivia: handoff QA checklist to test team (include a11y + RTL), Maria: finalize label choice (Serve vs Inference) — will run a quick hallway poll. We'll reconvene after prototype fixes. :sparkles:
